name: Enzai Shikkou Yuugi Yurukill
original_name: 冤罪執行遊戯ユルキル
source:
Accused of arson and the murders of 21 people, protagonist Shunju Sengoku is forced to fight for his freedom and prove his innocence. As one of six Prisoners, he must pair up with one of five victims, referred to as Executioners, within the confines of the strange and secluded amusement park known as Yurukill Land.

Together each of the five teams—Mass Murderers, Death Dealing Duo, Crafty Killers, Sly Stalkers, and Peeping Toms—must face and overcome the entertainment venue's so-called "attractions" in order to attain what they desire. Should the Prisoners succeed, their crimes shall be pardoned. But if the Executioners win, they will be granted revenge for their loved ones.

[Edited from [url=https://www.nisamerica.com/games/yurukill]NIS America[/url]]
translation:
主角春秋千石被指控纵火并杀害21人，被迫为重获自由、证明清白而战。在古怪而与世隔绝的Yurukill乐园中，六名“囚犯”必须与五名被称为“执行人”的受害者搭档，而他正是其中一名囚犯。

大规模杀人小队、双胞胎杀人小队、阴谋杀人小队、跟踪狂杀人小队，以及偷窥狂小队——五支队伍必须携手闯过这座娱乐场所中所谓的“游乐设施”，才能实现各自的愿望。囚犯若能成功，罪行便会获得赦免；执行人若能胜出，则可为自己珍爱的人复仇。

[编译自[url=https://www.nisamerica.com/games/yurukill]NIS America[/url]]
